home.hero_headline: Film a bridge for 30 seconds. SETU measures how it vibrates.
home.hero_explanation: Mobile cameras track structural motion at sub-pixel scale. SETU separates bridge movement from camera shake to extract resonant frequencies.
home.step1_desc: Aim at a deck, pier, or stay cable. Rest the phone against a rigid railing or tripod to reduce hand shake.
home.step2_desc: SAM tracks structural edges frame by frame against a stationary background to cancel camera movement.
home.step3_desc: Eulerian video magnification amplifies microscopic movement and reveals the dominant vibration frequency.
home.real_scan_desc: Magnified video and power spectral density plot from Napier Bridge benchmark.
home.real_scan_missing: No completed scan is currently loaded. Film a bridge or choose an entry from the map to view real video and spectrum plots.

scan.title: Film a bridge
scan.subtitle: Film the bridge for 30 seconds to measure how it vibrates.
scan.drive_warning: Never record while driving. Stop safely first.
scan.privacy_note: Video and location are stored for analysis. SETU does not assess safety.
scan.select_video_prompt: Choose a video or film with camera
scan.target_prompt_label: What part of the bridge are you filming?
scan.target_prompt_desc: For example: concrete pillar, road deck, or stay cable.
scan.background_prompt_desc: Keep a building or hill in view so SETU can cancel your hand shake.
scan.tip1_desc: Rest the phone on a solid railing or wall. If you're in a vehicle, park and switch the engine off first; engine vibration spoils the reading.
scan.tip2_desc: Turn off video stabilisation if your camera has the option.
scan.tip3_desc: Fill the screen with the part of the bridge you are filming.
scan.tip4_desc: Keep a building or hill in view so SETU can cancel your hand shake.

result.demo_banner: Demo result: sample data, not a real measurement
result.verdict_usable_desc: Good reading. Bridge vibration was clearly detected.
result.verdict_weak_desc: Weak reading. Not enough bridge movement or too much camera shake. This is not a structural fault.
result.verdict_failed_desc: No clear vibration detected. Try filming again closer to the bridge with phone rested on a railing.
result.no_magnified_video: Magnified video was not generated for this scan.
result.psd_subtitle: Frequency spectrum computed from tracked sub-pixel motion.
result.no_psd_desc: The pipeline did not return a raw PSD array. Showing plot image if present.
result.vibration_graph_desc: The peak shows how fast the bridge vibrates under traffic and wind.
